in_marathi.name: Azmal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Azmal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Azmal is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Aham' meaning 'I' and 'Zama' meaning 'Will'. It symbolizes the power of an individual's will, guided by the divine will of the universe.
